name: ZSP_JOB_DETAILS
description: This table is used to store the details information for a batch thread.

columns.name: JOB_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key from ZSP_JOBS table. Primary Key

columns.name: OPTY_EVENT_LEARNED_NUM
columns.description: Total number of events corresponding to the opportunities that are learned by the model for a job.

columns.name: OPTY_CLOSED_LEARNED_NUM
columns.description: Total number of closed opportunities that are learned by the model and can be used for prediction

columns.name: EARLIEST_OPTY_CLOSE_DT
columns.description: The earliest close date of all opportunities for a job.

columns.name: LATEST_OPTY_CLOSE_DT
columns.description: The latest close date of all opportunities for a job.

columns.name: RECOMMEND_NUM
columns.description: Total number of recommendations (customer, product combination) that are generated by the model for a job.

columns.name: RECOMMEND_CUST_NUM
columns.description: Total number of customers which will be processed for this job.  Used for both training and lead gen jobs.

columns.name: LEARNED_CUST_NUM
columns.description: Number of customers processed so far.  Used for both training and lead gen jobs.

columns.name: CHILD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Child request Id from ESS Job.

columns.name: MARKETING_JOB_ID
columns.description: Marketing ODI import job will generate this ID.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
